import argparse
import sys
import re
from pysilfont.ufo import Ufo
from pysilfont.ftml import FTML
from pysilfont.csvreader import csvreader
from pysilfont.loggerobj import loggerobj

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate FTML from UFO and glyph data CSV using pysilfont.")
    parser.add_argument("--input-ufo", required=True, help="Input UFO directory")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output FTML file")
    parser.add_argument("--glyph-info-csv", required=True, help="Glyph info CSV file")
    parser.add_argument("--font-code", required=False, help="Font code")
    parser.add_argument("--log", required=False, help="Log file name")
    parser.add_argument("--langtags", nargs='*', default=[], help="List of BCP47 language tags")
    parser.add_argument("--rtl", action="store_true", help="Enable right-to-left feature")
    parser.add_argument("--no-rendercheck", action="store_true", help="Disable rendering check")
    parser.add_argument("--test-name", required=False, help="Test name")
    parser.add_argument("--font-src", required=False, help="Font source")
    parser.add_argument("--text-scale", type=float, default=1.0, help="Text scaling factor")
    parser.add_argument("--anchor-regex", required=False, help="Anchor points regular expression")
    parser.add_argument("--total-width", type=int, default=0, help="Total width of all string column")
    parser.add_argument("--xsl", required=False, help="XSL stylesheet")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Set up logging
    log = loggerobj(args.log) if args.log else None

    # Load UFO font
    ufo = Ufo(args.input_ufo)

    # Read glyph info CSV
    glyph_data = []
    with open(args.glyph_info_csv, encoding="utf-8") as csvfile:
        reader = csvreader(csvfile)
        for row in reader:
            glyph_data.append(row)

    # Initialize FTML document
    ftml = FTML()
    if args.test_name:
        ftml.testname = args.test_name
    if args.font_src:
        ftml.fontsrc = args.font_src
    if args.xsl:
        ftml.xsl = args.xsl
    if args.langtags:
        for lang in args.langtags:
            ftml.addLang(lang)
    if args.rtl:
        ftml.rtl = True
    if args.no_rendercheck:
        ftml.rendercheck = False
    if args.text_scale:
        ftml.textscale = args.text_scale
    if args.total_width:
        ftml.totalwidth = args.total_width

    # Add font info
    ftml.addfontinfo(ufo)

    # Process glyph data
    anchor_regex = re.compile(args.anchor_regex) if args.anchor_regex else None

    for row in glyph_data:
        glyphname = row.get("glyphname") or row.get("name")
        if not glyphname:
            continue
        unicode_val = row.get("unicode")
        is_special = row.get("special", "").lower() == "yes"
        is_ligature = row.get("ligature", "").lower() == "yes"
        is_lam_alef = row.get("lamalef", "").lower() == "yes"
        is_diacritic = row.get("diacritic", "").lower() == "yes"
        anchors = row.get("anchors", "")

        # Encoded characters
        if unicode_val and not is_special and not is_ligature:
            try:
                codepoint = int(unicode_val, 16)
                char = chr(codepoint)
                ftml.addChar(char, glyphname=glyphname)
            except Exception as e:
                if log: log.log(f"Error adding char {glyphname}: {e}")

        # Specials
        if is_special:
            ftml.addSpecial(glyphname)

        # Ligatures
        if is_ligature:
            lig_components = row.get("components", "")
            if lig_components:
                ftml.addLigature(glyphname, lig_components.split())

        # Lam-Alef data
        if is_lam_alef:
            lam = row.get("lam")
            alef = row.get("alef")
            if lam and alef:
                ftml.addLamAlef(glyphname, lam, alef)

        # Diacritic attachment data
        if is_diacritic and anchors:
            anchor_list = anchors.split()
            if anchor_regex:
                anchor_list = [a for a in anchor_list if anchor_regex.match(a)]
            ftml.addDiacritic(glyphname, anchor_list)

    # Write FTML file
    with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as outfile:
        ftml.write(outfile)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
